Tap an assignment to change it. Swipe actions vary continuously; tap actions use one step. Hold the video for 2× speed; release to restore it. Two-finger double-tap resets zoom. Subtitle mode keeps caption gestures separate. Start away from navigation edges.

Videos and Music: tap Allow access to read indexed media and show folders and file counts inside TN-Player. View & layout controls list/grid, sorting and filters. On Android 14 and newer, selected-video access shows only the videos Android grants. Tap Allow all media or use app permission settings to expand access.\n\nUse Add from storage in the menu to explicitly open a file or folder from an SD card, USB drive or document provider. In Files, tap a folder to enter or use its menu for copy, move, rename, share and delete. Copy/move supports individual files.

Folders contain accessible indexed media only. Android may omit .nomedia and protected locations. Use Add from storage → Open a folder for other provider storage.\n\nDate means last modified. Played time/status use the history retained by TN-Player (up to 200 items). Folder length/size are totals; date/played time use the newest member. Capture fps is the capture rate indexed by Android, not a guaranteed encoded frame rate; unavailable values sort as zero.

Tap a local media file to play its accessible folder in order, starting at that file. The track indicator shows your position in the queue. Playlist Play all uses playlist order. Me → Library diagnostics shows which filters affect the Music tab. Long-press an indexed folder to hide it; manage it under Hidden folders. Show hidden folders restores these folders to browsing and search. Dot-prefixed names have a separate setting. Playback notification visibility depends on Android settings.
